name: ati-dev-cockpit
description: Painel web para monitorar e operar processos PM2 no Windows

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @ati-dev-cockpit/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @ati-dev-cockpit/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ati-dev-cockpit/frontend && npm run build --workspace @ati-dev-cockpit/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ati-dev-cockpit/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace @ati-dev-cockpit/backend
